meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw 智能体组注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务,新增网页搜索和 URL 内容提取两个工具,不需要 API 密钥;Claude、OpenCode、Codex 等支持 MCP 的 provider 都能调用。
howto.when: 当你给某个智能体组安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 内容提取、且不使用 API 密钥时。Claude provider 的组已有内置 WebSearch 和 WebFetch,该技能对其他 provider 的组作用更大。

say.text: 给 group-xxx 装上 Tavily 搜索和提取工具
say.note: 先查桥接包,再注册服务器

say.text: 看看我的组里 Tavily 工具装上没、能不能用
say.note: 读存储配置并看一次测试调用

say.text: Tavily 报 429 了,怎么换成我自己的密钥?
say.note: 会给出预填的 OneCLI 升级链接

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for chosen NanoClaw agent groups, adding two tools: web search and URL content extraction, with no API key. Any MCP-capable provider (Claude, OpenCode, Codex) can call them.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for an agent group without an API key. Claude-provider groups already have built-in WebSearch and WebFetch.

say_en.text: Install Tavily search and extract for group <group-id>
say_en.note: Checks the bridge, then registers the server

say_en.text: Check whether the Tavily tools are registered and working in my group
say_en.note: Reads stored config and a test call

say_en.text: Tavily returned 429 - how do I switch to my own API key?
say_en.note: Offers the prefilled OneCLI upgrade link
